question: Which city has been selected to host Olympics - 2032 by IOC on 21 July 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Brisbane**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Brisbane** has been selected to host the 2032 Olympics by the International Olympic Committee (IOC).
 
• The decision was made on **21 July 2021** during an IOC session in Tokyo.
 
• Brisbane is the third Australian city to host the Olympics, following Melbourne in 1956 and Sydney in 2000.
 
• The selection of Brisbane aims to promote a sustainable and economically viable approach to hosting the Olympics, leveraging existing infrastructure and facilities.
 
• The 2032 Olympics will feature innovative and inclusive events that align with the evolving vision of the Olympic movement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **International Olympic Committee (IOC)** is responsible for selecting the host city for the Olympic Games.
 
• The selection process involves a thorough evaluation of the candidate cities' proposals, including their infrastructure, financial stability, and plans for legacy and sustainability.
 
• Brisbane's bid was praised for its strong government support, existing sports facilities, and commitment to sustainability and legacy planning.
 
• The **Olympic Games** are a major international multi-sport event, held every four years, with summer and winter editions.
 
• The Games bring together athletes from around the world to compete in various sports, promoting peace, unity, and international cooperation through sports.
